name: Bo Bragason
bio: Bo Bragason is an English actress. She is known for her roles in the BBC series 'The Jetty' and King & Conqueror, the Disney + series Renegade Nell, and the Amazon Prime series Sterling Point. She also performed in the stage adaptation of ‘force majeure’ at the Donmar Warehouse in London that ran from December 2021 - February 2022.
